dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans seeking mental health care, outpatient mental health facilities receiving grants, and Department of Veterans Affairs administration.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a three-year pilot program under which the Secretary shall make grants to eligible mental health care providers for the provision of mental health care to veterans

dimensions.assessment: Provides grant funding up to $1,500,000 per facility annually to expand veteran access to culturally competent mental health care and support services.
dimensions.evidence: no grant under the pilot program for a facility for any fiscal year may exceed $1,500,000

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $20,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029 to carry out the pilot program.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out the pilot program under this section $20,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029.

dimensions.assessment: Directs the creation of a specific three-year VA grant pilot program and makes minor adjustments to housing loan fee expiration dates.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall carry out a three-year pilot program under which the Secretary shall make grants to eligible mental health care providers

dimensions.assessment: The pilot program operates for a fixed duration of three years (fiscal years 2027 through 2029), while the housing loan fee table date is extended slightly.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall carry out a three-year pilot program... $20,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029.

missing_information: The exact total number of facilities or veterans expected to be served nationwide under the pilot program.
Long-term plans for the pilot program after the three-year authorization period expires.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a three-year pilot program providing grants up to $1,500,000 per facility for outpatient mental health care providers serving veterans, with an authorization of appropriations of $20,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029, and makes a minor modification to VA housing loan fee tables.
